name: Spicy Brown Mustard
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated on SIBO diets as mustard seeds are naturally low in fermentable carbohydrates.
preparationTips: Check labels for added garlic or onion powder which would make it high FODMAP
Look for brands with simple ingredients: mustard seeds, vinegar, salt, and spices
Store opened mustard in refrigerator for best quality
A little goes a long way for flavor enhancement
nutritionalHighlights: Provides small amounts of magnesium and phosphorus
